benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
benchmarks.caveat: Live, transparent, anti-gaming methodology; but funding/ownership stays off-site and payer/rated conflict undisclosed formally.

benchmarks.name: Arena (LMArena) Text Leaderboard
benchmarks.caveat: Confirmed gaming precedent + VC conflicts + frontier saturation; live/current/largest-sample: use for broad tiering, not top-10 rank

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.caveat: Meta owns 49% of Scale/HLE; Meta's model ranks on it; ~29% bio/chem error rate confirmed: still discriminates, disclose ties.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.caveat: Well-governed but semi-private track admits overfitting risk; chat-model frontier already exceeds human baseline (92.5% vs ~60%).

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-3
benchmarks.caveat: Live and unsaturated but founder-run for-profit is top funder; predecessor contamination history; tests agentic play not chat model output.

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath
benchmarks.caveat: OpenAI funded+saw problems undisclosed till launch; 42% error rate fixed only June 2026; self-reported scores proven inflated 2.5x.

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.caveat: Saturated at frontier (93-95%, cross-tracker noise ≈ model spread); creators' own group says top scores partly reflect predicting flawed answers.

benchmarks.name: LiveBench
benchmarks.caveat: Live, objective, no-LLM-judge scoring at the source; single-vendor funder, no COI disclosure; cite livebench.ai directly, not stale mirrors.

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Pro
benchmarks.caveat: Saturated at frontier (4 trackers, 4 different #1s, <2pt spread); legit academic origin, static 2yr set, no gaming found.

benchmarks.name: GDPval / GDPval-AA v2
benchmarks.caveat: OpenAI owns/authors the task corpus and self-judges via GPT-5.5; ~30% grading noise; top-2 gap is statistical noise.

benchmarks.name: SimpleQA Verified
benchmarks.caveat: Google creates, hosts, and currently tops its own leaderboard; treat as directional signal, not neutral ranking.

benchmarks.name: FACTS Benchmark Suite
benchmarks.caveat: Google builds/hosts/self-judges via owned Kaggle; Gemini judges 2/4 legs; usable as relative signal only, not proof of superiority

benchmarks.name: Scale AI SEAL / SEAL Showdown
benchmarks.caveat: Meta owns 49%+its Chief AI Officer sits on Scale's board scoring his own lab's models; sound stats, no confirmed rigging yet.

benchmarks.name: SimpleBench (AI Explained)
benchmarks.caveat: Live, dual-mirrored, but near-saturated (81.9 vs 83.7 human), n=9 baseline, undisclosed grading method, prompting-sensitive.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.caveat: Funder's own audit proved contamination+broken tests; 3 gaming incidents; frontier-saturated; successor also retracted.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Pro
benchmarks.caveat: Live Meta 49% COI scoring its own model, OpenAI retracted its endorsement over 30% broken tasks, unpatched reward-hacking exploit.

benchmarks.name: LiveCodeBench
benchmarks.caveat: Problem pool frozen since Apr 2025, self-reported scores, near-saturated top tier; use as historical snapshot only.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.x
benchmarks.caveat: Real leaderboard cheating + unpatched harness exploit found; still discriminates: must name score source (tbench.ai vs AA diverge).

benchmarks.name: Aider Polyglot Leaderboard
benchmarks.caveat: Sound execution-graded methodology, no capture, but stale since Oct 2025: missing all 2026 frontier models

benchmarks.name: METR Time Horizon
benchmarks.caveat: Self-admitted frontier saturation, on-suite reward-hacking, 20-35% methodology-driven swings; still best macro-trend reference.

benchmarks.name: GAIA
benchmarks.caveat: Grader exploited to ~98% (Berkeley RDI, Apr 2026); HAL paused; creators shipped GAIA2 successor; no clean citable split.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld 2.0 / OSWorld-Verified
benchmarks.caveat: OSWorld 2.0 discriminates and is live; -Verified branch is saturated and its BenchJack-exploited gold files remain unpatched.

benchmarks.name: WebArena-Verified
benchmarks.caveat: ServiceNow-run; BenchJack never retested it; raw gold-answer file still shipped; near-zero adoption; unverified since Mar 2026.

benchmarks.name: tau2-bench
benchmarks.caveat: Owner's CEO chairs OpenAI's board, Google GV invests; open+pass^k discriminate, but pin version, skip aggregators.

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp
benchmarks.caveat: Self-reported scores dominate; Anthropic found a model decrypting the answer key; use only for coarse ranking.

benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2
benchmarks.caveat: Unsaturated, actively updated, but single-operator harness with real lab-funding COI and no independent replication.

benchmarks.name: Cybench
benchmarks.caveat: Saturated at frontier (near-100%), documented flag-fetching cheats, self-reported leaderboard; still valid as sub-frontier floor gate.

benchmarks.name: HAL (Holistic Agent Leaderboard)
benchmarks.caveat: Independent, not vendor-captured, but frozen since Jul 2026 and published rankings shown statistically unreliable by outside analysis.

benchmarks.name: Arena Search Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Only live search arena found; but paid lab-optimization revenue + admitted org-bias + 9-way tie below #1.

benchmarks.name: DeepResearch Bench (USTC)
benchmarks.caveat: Active & unsaturated, but judge=contestant self-preference (Gemini→now GPT-5.5) and rampant collision with FutureSearch's same-named bench

benchmarks.name: Deep Research Bench (FutureSearch)
benchmarks.caveat: Frozen-corpus, non-saturated, no gaming found; but lead investor + clients include labs it ranks, esp. Anthropic.

benchmarks.name: FreshQA
benchmarks.caveat: Cadence dead 11+ wks past self-set date; core search-vs-memorization signal empirically broken (74.3%); Google self-grades own model.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Image Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Live + published Elo methodology, but demonstrated de-anonymization exploit and paid private-benchmarking ties to ranked labs warrant caution.

benchmarks.name: Arena.ai Image/Video Arenas
benchmarks.caveat: Live+discriminates at top, but pay-to-be-ranked conflict + proven deanonymization exploit; trust only high-vote entries.

benchmarks.name: VBench / VBench-2.0
benchmarks.caveat: Academic, no vendor-pay found; v1 saturating, board stale since Apr 2026, circulating numbers often vendor self-reported.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Video Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Real blind-vote methodology, no-pay-for-rank disclosure, but anonymous/unverified entrants (HappyHorse) rank top-5; re-verify live, exclude unverified models.

benchmarks.name: TTS Arena V2
benchmarks.caveat: Live human-blind Elo, but a manipulated model held #1 undetected for months; top-10 is statistically noisy.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Human-voted, cost-normalized, refreshes 4x/daily; but #1/#2 statistically tied, funding self-disclosed only, rival arena disagrees entirely.

benchmarks.name: Voice Arena (voicearena.com)
benchmarks.caveat: Live, methodologically rigorous, vendor-independent (academic-funded); but ~4 months old, thin team, no disclosed vote-scale or audit.

benchmarks.name: Open ASR Leaderboard
benchmarks.caveat: NVIDIA co-authors methodology its own models top; AMI gaming (Jul 2026) exceeds leading margin; private-eval fix is opt-in, not default.

benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench
benchmarks.caveat: Self-reported-only leaderboard (0/16 verified), operator's own MinerU tops it, saturated top cluster; floor test only, not ranking.

benchmarks.name: OCRBench v2
benchmarks.caveat: Self-reported/0-verified scores + ByteDance co-authorship; still unsaturated + peer-reviewed + genuinely refreshed, use with disclosure.

benchmarks.name: OCR Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Vendor-operated by Extend, YC-investor-amplified, undisclosed vote volumes, formatting-biased crowd votes; still discriminates, cross-checkable via idp-leaderboard.

benchmarks.name: HarmBench
benchmarks.caveat: Frozen since Aug 2024; own judge tested near-random in 2026; single-turn ASR misses multi-turn jailbreak reality.

benchmarks.name: AgentHarm
benchmarks.caveat: Solid methodology/contamination controls, actively maintained infra, but frozen 2024 judge/content and unconfirmed 2026 frontier discrimination.

benchmarks.name: Phare LLM Benchmark
benchmarks.caveat: Self-authored methodology + Anthropic-family judge seat + paid-audit vendor motive; still discriminates, govt-funded, actively updated.

benchmarks.name: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub / ECI
benchmarks.caveat: OpenAI-funded FrontierMath COI (disclosed late) plus SWE-bench Verified kept in ECI after OpenAI called it contaminated.

benchmarks.name: Vellum LLM Leaderboard
benchmarks.caveat: VC-funded, model-agnostic aggregator; real data but no published methodology, and still headlines contaminated/disavowed SWE-bench: treat as directory, not authority.

benchmarks.name: BenchLM.ai
benchmarks.caveat: Solo aggregator, no independent recompute/contamination check, unaudited ad firewall, confirmed within-page stale copy; still discriminates at frontier.

benchmarks.name: llm-stats.com
benchmarks.caveat: Owner traceable (ZeroEval/YC S25); blended score sane but LiveBench subpage confirmed stale (o3-mini #1); undisclosed Google-backer conflict.

benchmarks.name: OpenRouter Rankings
benchmarks.caveat: Token-volume telemetry, not quality; misleading copy, gameable via free-tier promos, Alphabet a material investor: label as adoption signal.

benchmarks.name: Deep SWE (Data Curve)
benchmarks.caveat: Real gains but self-graded flagship claim, confirmed cost bug, 4 broken golds, vendor-sales conflict, early re-saturation.
